rationale.text: The page holds one title element, a child of head, with text. The test asks whether each page has a page title given by the title tag, and the methodology validates the test once it finds the title structured with a title element. The custom check answers no_fault (its step 3: the first title element is a child of head and its text holds letters), so the one resolving link is satisfied. At full the finding is passed; at fail_only the entry may not say passed, so it is needs_review, not_enabled. Whether the title is relevant is criterion 8.6, not this test.

citations.quote: Chaque page web a-t-elle un titre de page (balise `<title>`) ?
Retrouver dans le document le titre structuré au moyen d’un élément `<title>` ;
Si c’est le cas, **le test est validé**.
Pour chaque page web ayant un titre de page, ce titre est-il pertinent ?
